audience: University students in Pakistan starting their AI journey

brief.title: A Practical Roadmap for Pakistani University Students to Learn Machine Learning from Scratch
brief.meta_description: A step-by-step guide for Pakistani university students starting their AI journey, covering essential math and Python skills, project-based learning, and clear career pathways in machine learning.
brief.h1: Getting Started with Machine Learning: A Beginner's Guide for Pakistani University Students

outline.h2: Foundational Skills: Math and Python Basics
coverage_notes: Explain why linear algebra and probability are core to ML.
Highlight free resources like Khan Academy and Coursera for math.
Show how to set up a Python environment and use Jupyter notebooks.
Compare live courses with self-study for flexibility.
Mention Pakistan AI Online Academy's beginner course that requires no prior coding (S1-C9).
Discuss Nizi Solutions' live online training with certification and job placement support (S3-C7).

outline.h2: Hands-On Projects to Build a Portfolio
coverage_notes: Provide concrete project ideas such as customer churn prediction or healthcare data analysis.
Explain the steps from data collection to model deployment.
Show how to document and share projects on GitHub or personal websites.

outline.h2: Career Pathways in AI for Pakistani Students
coverage_notes: Outline roles like Data Analyst, Junior ML Engineer, and AI Research Assistant.
Discuss the growing AI industry in Pakistan and job prospects.
Suggest next steps for advanced learning and certifications.
List free platforms such as Coursera, edX, and YouTube tutorials.
Mention local community meetups and hackathons.
Highlight the importance of continuous learning.
